nodes.name: Every 15 minutes
nodes.notes: At 10, 25, 40 and 55 past the hour: five minutes before each round of summaries (summarisation.json starts at 0, 15, 30 and 45), so a document read here is summarised at once. The dashboard's file list says when a waiting document will be read from these times (READ_MINUTES in dashboard/app/services/drive.py).

nodes.name: Read the Drive folder
nodes.notes: The association's one Drive folder for the newsletter: new and changed documents become articles of the source Google Drive, summarised by the summarisation workflow like any other, and the articles of documents that have left the folder are taken out. The dashboard holds the Google key and the guard that keeps the tool in that folder; this only asks it to read. While Drive is off or not set up there is nothing to do. dashboard/app/services/drive.py, docs/drive.md, db/init/33-drive.sql.
